# Ixia UI React

> Styled React components, hooks, and utilities built with composable primitives and Tailwind CSS 4.

Import from individual `ixia-ui-react/<subpath>` entry points; there is no aggregate root import. Import `ixia-ui-react/styles` once and process it with Tailwind CSS 4.

Ixia wraps some Base UI primitives, but its exports and component composition can differ from Base UI. Prefer the Ixia references and examples below.

## Guides

- [Getting started](docs/llms/guides/getting-started.md): Installation, imports, and optional peers.
- [Styling and themes](docs/llms/guides/styling.md): Tailwind CSS, tokens, and brand themes.
- [Component composition](docs/llms/guides/composition.md): Button, dialog, select, and autocomplete examples.
- [Forms](docs/llms/guides/forms.md): TanStack React Form integration and field composition.

## Components

- [Accordion](docs/llms/components/accordion.md): `ixia-ui-react/accordion`. The Accordion component displays collapsible content panels.
- [Alert](docs/llms/components/alert.md): `ixia-ui-react/alert`. The Alert component is a specialized container for displaying time-sensitive or important messages.
- [Alert Dialog](docs/llms/components/alert-dialog.md): `ixia-ui-react/alert-dialog`. The Alert Dialog component blocks interaction with the rest of the application until the user explicitly confirms or cancels.
- [Autocomplete](docs/llms/components/autocomplete.md): `ixia-ui-react/autocomplete`. Autocomplete improves text entry by surfacing matching suggestions in real time.
- [Avatar](docs/llms/components/avatar.md): `ixia-ui-react/avatar`. The Avatar component visually represents a person, team member, or entity.
- [Badge](docs/llms/components/badge.md): `ixia-ui-react/badge`. The Badge component conveys small pieces of information, such as statuses, categories, or counts.
- [Bento Box](docs/llms/components/bento-box.md): `ixia-ui-react/bento-box`. The Bento Box component is a versatile container that allows for the organization of content into a structured and visually appealing layout.
- [Breadcrumb](docs/llms/components/breadcrumb.md): `ixia-ui-react/breadcrumb`. The Breadcrumb component communicates the current location within a hierarchy of pages or views.
- [Button](docs/llms/components/button.md): `ixia-ui-react/button`. The Button component is the primary action trigger across the interface.
- [Button Group](docs/llms/components/button-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/button-group`. The Button Group component combines related buttons into one cohesive unit.
- [Calendar](docs/llms/components/calendar.md): `ixia-ui-react/calendar`. A calendar component that allows users to select dates and view events.
- [Chart](docs/llms/components/chart.md): `ixia-ui-react/chart`. A responsive chart container that sizes its Recharts child to the available space.
- [Checkbox](docs/llms/components/checkbox.md): `ixia-ui-react/checkbox`. The Checkbox component supports binary and partial selection states for forms, filters, and settings.
- [Checkbox Group](docs/llms/components/checkbox-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/checkbox-group`. Checkbox Group manages shared selection state for multiple checkbox items.
- [Code Block](docs/llms/components/code-block.md): `ixia-ui-react/code-block`. CodeBlock manages selection, layout, copying, and downloading without depending on a syntax highlighter.
- [Collapsible](docs/llms/components/collapsible.md): `ixia-ui-react/collapsible`. The Collapsible component is used to create collapsible sections of content.
- [Color Channel Slider](docs/llms/components/color-channel-slider.md): `ixia-ui-react/color-channel-slider`. The Color Channel Slider adjusts a single channel of a color, such as hue, saturation, lightness or transparency, over a track that previews the resulting colors.
- [Color Picker](docs/llms/components/color-picker.md): `ixia-ui-react/color-picker`. The Color Picker lets users choose a color with a saturation/lightness area, hue, transparency and lightness sliders, and a typed value input that switches between formats.
- [Combobox](docs/llms/components/combobox.md): `ixia-ui-react/combobox`. The Combobox component allows users to select an option from a dropdown list.
- [Context Menu](docs/llms/components/context-menu.md): `ixia-ui-react/context-menu`. The Context Menu component exposes contextual actions tied to a specific surface or selection.
- [Copy Button](docs/llms/components/copy-button.md): `ixia-ui-react/copy-button`. Copies a string to the clipboard and renders temporary success feedback through a children render function.
- [Dialog](docs/llms/components/dialog.md): `ixia-ui-react/dialog`. Dialog presents an overlay and popup that temporarily interrupts the page for focused work.
- [Drawer](docs/llms/components/drawer.md): `ixia-ui-react/drawer`. The Drawer component presents supplementary content in a panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.
- [Dropzone](docs/llms/components/dropzone.md): `ixia-ui-react/dropzone`. The Dropzone lets users upload files by dragging them into an area or browsing from their device.
- [Field](docs/llms/components/field.md): `ixia-ui-react/field`. `Field` lays out **one** form control with its label and supporting text.
- [Form](docs/llms/components/form.md): `ixia-ui-react/form`. `Form` renders a native `<form>` wired to TanStack Form state.
- [Icon](docs/llms/components/icon.md): `ixia-ui-react/icon`. The Icon component renders the named system icons used across Ixia UI, such as chevrons, status indicators, file actions and sorting controls.
- [Icon Container](docs/llms/components/icon-container.md): `ixia-ui-react/icon-container`. IconContainer pairs an icon with a semantic background and foreground tone.
- [Input](docs/llms/components/input.md): `ixia-ui-react/input`. The Input component is a foundational form control for entering text and selecting colors.
- [Input Group](docs/llms/components/input-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/input-group`. Input Group combines one editable input with optional addons (icons, text labels, shortcuts, spinners, and buttons) into a single cohesive control.
- [Input OTP](docs/llms/components/input-otp.md): `ixia-ui-react/input-otp`. The Input OTP component provides a segmented input experience for collecting one-time passcodes.
- [Kbd](docs/llms/components/kbd.md): `ixia-ui-react/kbd`. The Kbd component highlights keyboard keys or shortcut combinations in compact keycap styling.
- [Label](docs/llms/components/label.md): `ixia-ui-react/label`. The Label component is used to provide descriptive text for form elements such as input fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons.
- [Layer Tree](docs/llms/components/layer-tree.md): `ixia-ui-react/layer-tree`. The Layer Tree component displays hierarchical data using TanStack Table.
- [Map](docs/llms/components/map.md): `ixia-ui-react/map`. Provider-independent map controls and layer state for composing map interfaces.
- [Menu](docs/llms/components/menu.md): `ixia-ui-react/menu`. The Menu component displays a popup list of actions anchored to a trigger.
- [Meter](docs/llms/components/meter.md): `ixia-ui-react/meter`. The Meter component visualizes bounded values such as upload progress, quota usage, battery levels, and background task completion.
- [Nav Bar](docs/llms/components/nav-bar.md): `ixia-ui-react/nav-bar`. NavBar is a compact bottom navigation surface composed of `NavBarItem`, `NavBarItemIcon`, and `NavBarItemLabel`.
- [Navigation Menu](docs/llms/components/navigation-menu.md): `ixia-ui-react/navigation-menu`. A collection of links and menus for website navigation, built on top of [Base UI NavigationMenu](https://base-ui.com/react/components/navigation-menu).
- [Number Field](docs/llms/components/number-field.md): `ixia-ui-react/number-field`. The Number Field component supports typed input, increment/decrement controls, and scrub-area dragging for fast numeric adjustments.
- [Popover](docs/llms/components/popover.md): `ixia-ui-react/popover`. The Popover component provides a way to display additional information or actions in a floating container that appears on user interaction, such as clicking or hovering over an element.
- [Preview Card](docs/llms/components/preview-card.md): `ixia-ui-react/preview-card`. A card component for previewing content.
- [Profile](docs/llms/components/profile.md): `ixia-ui-react/profile`. The Profile component combines avatar, user identity text, and optional right-side actions.
- [Progress](docs/llms/components/progress.md): `ixia-ui-react/progress`. The Progress component helps represent multi-step workflows such as onboarding, checkout, and setup flows.
- [Radar Ping](docs/llms/components/radar-ping.md): `ixia-ui-react/radar-ping`. The RadarPing renders an absolutely-positioned pulsing dot anchored to the top-right corner of its relative container.
- [Radio Group](docs/llms/components/radio-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/radio-group`. The Radio Group component lets users choose one value from a list of options.
- [Resizeable](docs/llms/components/resizeable.md): `ixia-ui-react/resizeable`. The Resizeable components are built for creating split-pane interfaces such as dashboards, editors, and tool workspaces.
- [Scroll Area](docs/llms/components/scroll-area.md): `ixia-ui-react/scroll-area`. ScrollArea provides a polished container for content that exceeds its visible bounds.
- [Select](docs/llms/components/select.md): `ixia-ui-react/select`. The Select component presents a controlled or uncontrolled choice list inside a popup.
- [Separator](docs/llms/components/separator.md): `ixia-ui-react/separator`. Separator visually partitions related content while preserving layout rhythm.
- [Sidebar](docs/llms/components/sidebar.md): `ixia-ui-react/sidebar`. Sidebar is a layout-aware navigation surface built from composable primitives such as groups, menu items, badges, and collapsible sections.
- [Site Header](docs/llms/components/site-header.md): `ixia-ui-react/site-header`. The SiteHeader component represents the top navigation bar of the application.
- [Skeleton](docs/llms/components/skeleton.md): `ixia-ui-react/skeleton`. The Skeleton component is used to display placeholder loading skeletons while content is being fetched or loaded.
- [Slider](docs/llms/components/slider.md): `ixia-ui-react/slider`. The Slider component allows users to select a value from a continuous or discrete range by dragging a thumb along a track.
- [Slider Group](docs/llms/components/slider-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/slider-group`. SliderGroup owns the shared value and configuration for a slider and its companions.
- [Switch](docs/llms/components/switch.md): `ixia-ui-react/switch`. The Switch component allows users to toggle between two states, such as on and off.
- [Table](docs/llms/components/table.md): `ixia-ui-react/table`. A composition-first data table built on TanStack Table.
- [Table Of Contents](docs/llms/components/table-of-contents.md): `ixia-ui-react/table-of-contents`. A table of contents that lists the headings of a long article and highlights the section currently in view.
- [Tabs](docs/llms/components/tabs.md): `ixia-ui-react/tabs`. The Tabs component allows users to navigate between different sections of content within the same context.
- [Text Area](docs/llms/components/text-area.md): `ixia-ui-react/text-area`. The TextArea component provides a multi-line input field that allows users to enter and edit larger amounts of text.
- [Toast](docs/llms/components/toast.md): `ixia-ui-react/toast`. Toast provides transient feedback for user actions.
- [Toggle](docs/llms/components/toggle.md): `ixia-ui-react/toggle`. The Toggle component allows users to switch between two states, such as on and off.
- [Toggle Group](docs/llms/components/toggle-group.md): `ixia-ui-react/toggle-group`. Toggle Group organizes related toggles into one control.
- [Tooltip](docs/llms/components/tooltip.md): `ixia-ui-react/tooltip`. Tooltip provides contextual hints without adding permanent UI clutter.
- [Google Map](docs/llms/components/map-google.md): `ixia-ui-react/map/google`. Google Maps components built on `@vis.gl/react-google-maps`, with Places search, deck.gl overlays, and Google Maps marker overlays.

## Hooks and utilities

- [Hooks](docs/llms/components/hooks.md): `ixia-ui-react/hooks`. Shared hooks for media queries and application color themes.
- [Utils](docs/llms/components/utils.md): `ixia-ui-react/utils`. Shared utilities for merging class names and formatting dates.

## Upstream

- [Base UI LLM index](https://base-ui.com/llms.txt): Upstream primitives and behavior; Ixia wrappers may differ.
